titleStmt.title: Mahābhārata Āraṇyakaparvan with the commentary of Caturbhujamiśra

msContents.summary: A manuscript of the Āraṇyakaparvan with commentary.

lg.l: jalāṃ copajalāṃ caiva yamānām abhito nadī ||
uśīnaro vai yatreṣṭvā vāsavād atyaricyata ||

tāṃ devasa
mitiṃ tasya vāsavasya viśāṃ pate ||
abhyagachata rājāna jñātum agniś ca bhārataḥ ||
jijñāsamānau varadau mahātmānam uśīnaraṃ ||

iṃdra śyena kapo
to gnir bhūtvā yava bhijagmatu ||
kuruṃ rājñaḥ samāsādya kapota śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī tathā rājan_ nililye bhayapīḍitaḥ ||
|| śṛṇu tvaṃ tatra vai rājan_ śyeno yad abhibhārataḥ ||

||
dharmmātmānaṃ tvām iha vai rajan_ vrāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
sa vai dharmaviruddhatvaṃ kasmāt karma cikīrṣasi || 1 ||

vihitaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ rājan_ pīḍyamāna
sya me kṣudhā ||
mā rakṣīd dharmmalobhena dharmmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 2 ||
|| satrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto mahādvijā ||

matsa
kaśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagaddhur ayaṃ dvijaḥ || 3 ||
evam abhyāgatasyādha kapotasyābhayārthinaḥ ||

||
abra dāne paro dharmmaḥ kathaṃ śyena na paśyasi ||4 ||
praspaṃdamānaḥ saṃbhrāṃtaḥ kapotaḥ śyena lakṣyate ||

matsakāśī jīvinārthī tasya tyāgo vigarhi
naḥ || 5 ||
yo hi kaścid dvijān_ hanyād gāvāṃ lokasya mātaraṃ ||
śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyajati tulyaṃ ṣāṃ hi pātakaṃ || 6 ||

|| āhārān_ sarvabhū
tāni saṃbhavaṃti mahītale ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhene tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 7 ||
śakyate dustyaje py arthe cirarātrāya jīvitaṃ ||

na tu bhojanam utsṛjya
śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciraṃ || 8 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||
visṛjya kāyam eṣyaṃti paṃthānam akuto bhayaṃ || 9 ||

manmṛte mayi
dharmātman_ putradāraṃ mariṣyati ||
rakṣan_ rājan_ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān na rakṣati || 10 ||
dharmma yo bādhate dharmmaṃ na sa dharmmaḥ kudharma tat ||
atirodhe hi yo dharmmaḥ sa dharmma satyavikramaḥ || 11 ||
virodheṣu mahīpāla niścitya gurulāghavaṃ ||

na vadho vidyate yatra taṃ dharmaṃ samupācaraḥ
|| 12 ||
gurulāghavam ajñāya dharmādharmaviniścaye ||
yano bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmaniścaye || 13 ||

|| bahukalyāṇasaṃ
yuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama ||
suparṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ kiṃ tvaṃ dharmmajñasyāspy asaṃśayaṃ || 14 ||
tathā hi dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu citraṃ ca bhāṣase ||

na tye sty a
viditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ || 15 ||
śaraṇaiṣi parityāgaṃ katha sādhv iti manyase ||

āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama ||
16 ||
śakyaś cāpy anyathā karttum āhāro bhyadhikas tvayā ||
govṛṣo vā varāho vā mṛgo vā mahiṣo pi vā || 17 || ||
tvadartham adya kriyatā yad vānyad iha kāṃkṣasi ||
|| na varāhaṃ na cokṣāṇaṃ na mṛgāṃś ca pṛthagvidhān || 18 ||

bhakṣayāmi mahīpāla ki
mamānye na kenacit ||
yas tu me daivavivihito bhakṣaḥ kṣatriyapuṃgavaṃ || 19 ||
tam utsṛjya mahīpāla nānyaṃ bhakṣaṃ mahaṃvṛṇe ||

śyena kaponan atīti¦
sthitir eṣa sanātanī || 20 ||
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āsaja ||
|| rājyaṃ śibīnām ṛddhaṃ vaiḥ dadāni tava khecaraḥ || 21
yad vā kāmayase kiṃcit_ śyena sarvaṃ dadāni te ||
vinemaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ śyena śaraṇārthinam āgataṃ || 22 ||

yenemaṃ varjjayethās tvaṃ karmmaṇā pakṣisattamaḥ
||
tadācakṣva kariṣyāmi na hi dāsye kapotakaṃ || 23 ||
uśīnara kapote te yadi sneho narādhipaḥ ||

ātmano māṃsam utkṛ
tya kapotaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ || 24 ||
yadā samaṃ kapotena tava māṃsaṃ bhave nṛpa ||
tadā pradeyaṃ tan mahya māṃse tuṣṭir bhaviṣyati || 25 ||

||
anugraham imaṃ manye śyena yan mābhiyācase ||
tanmāt te dya pradāsyāmi svamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ || 26 ||

|| utkṛtya
sa svayaṃ māṃsaṃ rājā paramadharmmavit ||
tulayāmāsa kauṃteya kapotena samaṃ vibho || 27 ||
dhriyamāṇaḥ kapotas tu māṃsenāty atiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni rājā prādād uśīnaraḥ || 28 ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ dhṛtaṃ ||

tata utkṛtamāṃso sāv aruroha svayaṃ cha
lāṃ || 29 ||
|| iṃdro ham asmi dharmmajña kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ || || ||
jijñāsamānau dharmme tvāṃ yajñavāḍham upāgatau || 30 ||
yat te māsāni gātrebhya ukṛtāni viśāṃ pate ||

eṣā te bhāsvatī karttir llokān abhibhaviṣyati
|| 31 ||
yāval loke manuṣyās tvaṃ kathayiṣyaṃti pārthivaḥ ||
tāvat kīrttiś ca lokāś ca sthāsyaṃti tava śāśvatāḥ || 32 ||

ity evaṃm utkā rājānam āru
roha divaṃ punaḥ ||
uśīnaro pi dharmātmā yā sā dharmeṇāvṛtya sodasī || 33 ||
vibhrājamāno vapuṣī āruroha tripiṣṭapaṃ ||

tad etat_ sadanaṃ rā
jan_ rākṣasasya mahātmanaḥ || 34 ||
paśya vainat mayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapramocitaṃ ||
atreva sanataṃ daivā munayaś ca sanātana || 35 ||

dṛśyaṃte brā
hmaṇai rājan_ puṇyavadbhir mmahātmabhiḥ ||
